📊 Schema Overview

This data dictionary provides the complete schema for the WISC AI system. The CommandGenerator uses these exact table/column names to generate accurate SQL queries.

-- Smart Tags Used by CommandGenerator SELECT * FROM Customers -- [T:Customers] [Role:Master] SELECT Balance FROM Accounts -- [C:Balance] [Role:Key] SELECT * FROM Transactions -- [T:Transactions] [Role:Transaction]

🏛️ Core Business Tables

👤
Customers

Master data for customers/debtors. Core entity for balance inquiries and transaction tracking.
[T:Customers] [Role:Master]

Column Type Constraints Description
CustomerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER PK, Clustered Primary key - System GUID
TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK → Tenants, Indexed Multi-tenancy isolation key
Name NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, Indexed Customer full name (Arabic supported)
Code NVARCHAR(50) Unique per tenant Business reference code
Phone NVARCHAR(20) Nullable Primary contact number
Email NVARCHAR(100) Nullable Email address
Address NVARCHAR(500) Nullable Physical address
IsActive BIT DEFAULT 1 Soft delete flag
CreatedAt DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE() Record creation timestamp
Balance DECIMAL(18,2) Computed/Trigger Current balance (debt/credit)

🔗 Relationships

  • One-to-Many: Customers → Transactions (CustomerId)
  • One-to-Many: Customers → Debts (CustomerId)
  • Many-to-One: Customers → Tenants (TenantId)
📒
Accounts (Chart of Accounts)

Chart of Accounts - Financial accounts for double-entry bookkeeping.
[T:Accounts] [Role:Master] [C:AccountType]

Column Type Constraints Description
AccountId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER PK Primary key
TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK, Indexed Tenant isolation
AccountCode NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, Unique Account number (e.g., 1100, 2100)
AccountName NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL Account name (Arabic/English)
AccountType NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, Expense
ParentAccountId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK → Accounts, Nullable Parent account for hierarchy
Balance DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT 0 Current account balance
IsActive BIT DEFAULT 1 Active status
💰
Transactions

All financial transactions - the core transaction log. Supports both simple and double-entry.
[T:Transactions] [Role:Transaction]

Column Type Constraints Description
TransactionId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER PK Primary key
TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK, Indexed Tenant isolation
CustomerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK → Customers, Indexed Related customer (nullable for internal)
TransactionDate DATETIME2 NOT NULL, Indexed Transaction timestamp
TransactionType NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL Invoice, Payment, Expense, Transfer, etc.
ReferenceNumber NVARCHAR(50) Nullable Invoice number, Receipt number, etc.
Description NVARCHAR(500) Nullable Transaction description
Amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL Transaction amount (positive = debit, negative = credit)
Currency NVARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'EGP' ISO currency code (EGP, USD, EUR)
ExchangeRate DECIMAL(18,6) DEFAULT 1 Rate to base currency
IsReversed BIT DEFAULT 0 Soft delete - reversed transaction
ReversedByTransactionId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK → Transactions, Nullable Link to reversing transaction
CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK → Users User who created
CreatedAt DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE() Creation timestamp
📋
TransactionDetails (Double-Entry Lines)

Double-entry bookkeeping lines. Each Transaction has 2+ lines (Debit and Credit must balance).
[T:TransactionDetails] [Role:Transaction]

Column Type Constraints Description
TransactionDetailId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER PK Primary key
TransactionId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK → Transactions, Indexed Parent transaction
AccountId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK → Accounts Chart of Accounts entry
DebitAmount DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT 0 Debit amount (0 if credit line)
CreditAmount DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT 0 Credit amount (0 if debit line)
Description NVARCHAR(255) Nullable Line description

🔗 Double-Entry Rule

For each Transaction: SUM(DebitAmount) = SUM(CreditAmount)
This is enforced by database trigger or application logic.

📦 Supporting Tables

🏷️
Categories

Categorization for products, expenses, and income types.
[T:Categories] [Role:Reference]

Column Type Constraints Description
CategoryId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER PK Primary key
TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK, Indexed Tenant isolation
CategoryName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL Category name
CategoryType NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL Product, Expense, Income, Asset
ParentCategoryId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK → Categories, Nullable Parent category for hierarchy
IsActive BIT DEFAULT 1 Active status
📦
Products

Product/Services catalog with pricing.
[T:Products] [Role:Master]

Column Type Constraints Description
ProductId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER PK Primary key
TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK, Indexed Tenant isolation
ProductCode NVARCHAR(50) Unique SKU or product code
ProductName NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL Product name
CategoryId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK → Categories Product category
UnitPrice DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT 0 Default selling price
CostPrice DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT 0 Cost of goods
StockQuantity INT DEFAULT 0 Current stock level
IsActive BIT DEFAULT 1 Active status
📊
Debts (Guarantees)

Customer debt/guarantee records. Separate from Transactions for quick balance lookups.
[T:Debts] [Role:Transaction]

Column Type Constraints Description
DebtId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER PK Primary key
TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK, Indexed Tenant isolation
CustomerId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK → Customers, Indexed Debtor customer
DebtDate DATETIME2 NOT NULL Date of debt record
OriginalAmount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL Original debt amount
PaidAmount DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT 0 Amount paid so far
RemainingAmount DECIMAL(18,2) Computed Original - Paid
Status NVARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Active' Active, Paid, Overdue, Cancelled
DueDate DATETIME2 Nullable Expected payment date
Description NVARCHAR(500) Nullable Debt description

⚙️ System Tables

🏢
Tenants (Multi-tenancy)

Multi-tenancy root table. Every business entity belongs to a tenant.
[T:Tenants] [Role:System]

Column Type Constraints Description
TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER PK Primary key - isolated tenant boundary
TenantName NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL Company/Organization name
DatabaseName NVARCHAR(100) Nullable Isolated DB name (if sharding)
IsActive BIT DEFAULT 1 Subscription status
CreatedAt DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE() Registration date
👤
Users

System users with authentication. Linked to Tenants for multi-tenant access.
[T:Users] [Role:System]

Column Type Constraints Description
UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER PK Primary key
TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER FK → Tenants, Indexed User's tenant
Email NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, Unique Login email
PasswordHash NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL Hashed password
FullName NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL Display name
Role NVARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'User' Admin, Accountant, Viewer
IsActive BIT DEFAULT 1 Account status
LastLoginAt DATETIME2 Nullable Last successful login

🏷️ Smart Tags Reference

Smart Tags are metadata annotations that help the CommandGenerator understand table/column purposes.

Tag Pattern Meaning Example
[T:TableName] Table identifier [T:Customers]
[C:ColumnName] Column identifier [C:Balance]
[Role:Master] Master data table (rarely changes) Customers, Accounts, Products
[Role:Transaction] Transaction table (frequent inserts) Transactions, Debts
[Role:Reference] Lookup/reference data Categories
[Role:Key] Key column for entity resolution Name, Code, Phone
[Role:View] Read-only column (no UPDATE) Balance (computed)
-- Example: How CommandGenerator uses Smart Tags -- User Query: "هاتلي فلوس أحمد" (Show Ahmed's balance) -- 1. Entity Resolution finds: [T:Customers] + [C:Name] [Role:Key] -- 2. Field Resolution finds: [T:Customers] + [C:Balance] [Role:View] -- 3. Generated SQL: SELECT Name, Balance FROM Customers WHERE Name LIKE '%Ahmed%' AND TenantId = 'current-tenant-guid';
